company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services sector, providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing context and supporting colleagues, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and simplifying work so it can move quickly for clients.

The company describes a collaborative, commercially driven environment, with hybrid working—typically three days a week in the office—and teams organized around product areas such as payments, risk, data platform and client experience. It highlights career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department, alongside team events across its offices. Employee feedback is mixed: colleagues are often described as friendly, while onboarding and training can vary between teams.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
